source: host ship round without Grok Bot
note: Dry mode prints the cycle and writes nothing. A green exact head is accepted once. A stale head is not. A PR dirty only because both sides appended scripts/offline-tests.txt is marked needs-rebase and is not patched. The same live SHA does not get a second dry run. Cleanup remaining other than 0 fails. The doorbell stays silent when the failure reason repeats.

assertions.note: Accept, stale head, rebase, one dry run per SHA, cleanup, and doorbell rules.
